name: 87123 · Albuquerque, NM
findings: ZIP 87123 (Albuquerque) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87123 (Albuquerque) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 87123 (Albuquerque) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
